rows.en: <operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>So he really was active in this world too, huh.
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Yeah. I did kind of expect it, since I first saw him over here.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>What would make someone even think up something this insane? We have to stop him...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)>Does he really worry you that much?
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yeah... I don't really know why, but...
<operator(1060,1)><speed(2)><color(4)>Barrel<ce()>... I'm glad you've decided to fight, but don't rush it.
<operator(23030,1)><speed(2)>No point catching him if you end up dead yourself.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)>That's right. He's not the only enemy out there.
<operator(1040,1)><speed(2)>Yes... Understood.
<operator(5010,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()>... If we capture him here, will that settle things?
<operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>What's up? You're being all cagey about it, like you're holding something back...
rows.notes: Idiom 'oku-ba ni mono ga hasamatta' (something stuck between the back teeth) = being evasive/beating around the bush.

rows.en: <operator(25010,1)><speed(2)>With your skills, Captain, I don't think you'd lose to that guy, though?
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Since we don't know his true strength, it simply means we can't let our guard down.
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>Huh, guess you're surprisingly good at reading people, <color(4)>Gain<ce()>.
rows.notes: '-san' on Gain dropped, per project convention.

rows.en: <operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>What's that supposed to mean?
<operator(21010,1)><speed(2)>I figured you were the type who's all 'as long as I'm fine, that's good enough.'
<operator(21020,1)><speed(2)>Come on, now...
<operator(17010,1)><speed(2)>That bastard! I'm gonna catch him fast!
<operator(19030,1)><speed(2)>We can't let that <color(5)>Berkt<ce()> guy keep doing as he pleases any longer!
<operator(19020,1)><speed(2)>That's right! Let's make him regret it!
<operator(19010,1)><speed(2)>But be careful... he's tough.
<operator(12051,1)><speed(2)><color(5)>Berkt<ce()> or whatever he's called, I'll crush him!
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Please don't push it too hard, okay? Backing you up isn't easy either.
<operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>Heh, I'm the only one riding an <color(4)>Aestivalis<ce()>, after all!
<operator(12051,1)><speed(2)>A little recklessness suits me perfectly!
<operator(12140,1)><speed(2)>Captain...
<operator(12031,1)><speed(2)>That's how she is, so let her do as she likes.

uncertainties.issue: 'kare' (him) throughout this scene = Berkt, per the prior scene (4004473) and 4004463's storyline; gender confirmed male in glossary char.berkt.

checked_decisions: Every row (0/19-21, 1/19-24, 1/59-66, 1/99-102, 1/139-144) compared line by line against the Japanese source; all match in meaning, subject/addressee, and tag order.
1/61 'taii' (Amuro's rank) rendered 'Captain' per orchestrator decision; consistent usage.
1/20 'kare' (him) = Berkt throughout, confirmed by scene 4004473 and the 4004463 storyline; accepted.
Names checked against glossary: Barrel, Berkt, Gain, Aestivalis - all match.
remaining_uncertainties: 1/20: 'him' = Berkt is an inference from the surrounding scenes, not restated in this scene's own text; kept per the translator's note.
